slots.name: lives saved
slots.sentence: As of end-2024 , the program had saved over 25 million lives, supported treatment for 21 million people, prevented 7.8 million babies from contracting HIV/AIDS, supported 6.6 million AIDS orphans and their caregivers, and strengthened pandemic preparedness in recipient countries , all at a cost of less than 0.08% of total U.S. FY 2024 government spending .
